Worth flagging against claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing's risk framing: that law's evidence base is functions already at or near an exact/matched state where combined indexed-addressing forms (lwzx/lfsx) are actively in play and get defeated by a typed intermediate. This function was never close to exact and its raw form was not achieving any combined-addressing form either (opcode multiset identical before/after conversion) -- there was no combined-addressing mode for the typed form to defeat. Struct-typing appears safe in this 'far from exact, high baseline register pressure, no active indexed-addressing mode' regime, which is distinct from the law's tested regime; this is one data point, not proposed as a new law given no second corroborating instance yet.

attributes.remaining_residual_diagnosis: Two independent mechanisms remain, both resistant to every axis above. (A) A whole-function saved-register (r20-r31, 12 registers) COLOR permutation, most visible in a swapped register-reuse PAIRING: target pairs the pre-loop 'available' local with the in-loop 'chunk' local onto one shared physical register (target r20, freed after available's single early use then reused once the do-while's per-iteration chunk is computed) and gives the later per-iteration 'tag' its OWN separate register (target r21, never reused); ours instead pairs (available, tag) together (ours r21) and gives 'chunk' its own fresh register (ours r20) -- verified via a first-def-order parse of both disassemblies (script and raw dumps discarded with the scratchpad; reproducible via tools/gdl/fnasm.py <unit> fn_800DB3D4 [--ours] and grepping first occurrences of each r2x register as a destination operand). This cascades: target's 'node' ends up on a mid-range register (r26) while ours gives it the top slot (r31, adjacent to 'stream'=r30); the very first divergence in the function, offset 0x10, is an opcode-CLASS difference (not just a register renumber) -- target emits 'addi r31,r3,0' for the stream-parameter home move, ours emits 'mr r30,r3' -- this is the single largest individual opcode-multiset delta and is presumably a downstream symptom of the same coloring divergence, not an independently fixable choice (mr-vs-addi form selection was not reproducible by any tried source change). (B) Three branch-form/statement-order clusters independent of (A): (B.1) @0x100-0x110 target / @0x100-0x108 ours -- target compiles the '!(stream[5]>available) return;' guard as a 2-instruction positive-branch-plus-unconditional-jump (bgt-forward, b-to-return), ours as a 1-instruction inverted branch (ble-to-return); confirmed NOT sensitive to negation-vs-<= source spelling (axis 3). (B.2) @0x2fc-0x330 -- the pos/node->dataOffset reassociation order from axis 5, target computes '(node->totalSize+4)+node->dataOffset' as two chained instructions reusing r3 (immediate-first), ours reassociates to register-combine-first/+immediate-last. (B.3) @0x37c-0x398 -- target computes 'length=(length+0x7ff)&0xfffff800;' BEFORE loading stream->writePos/highWater for the following if-statement (matching straightforward source-statement order); ours hoists the two loads BEFORE the length clamp instead. Net effect of B.1-B.3 together: target carries 2 extra branch instructions ours lacks, ours carries 1 extra bge target lacks, netting the observed 278-vs-277 insn-count gap exactly.
